regions.title: Coast Mountains
regions.text: Whistler leads with 28" over the window, and its biggest day is Friday with 14". Expect rain for much of the early week, so the good snow comes at the end. Cypress Mountain sees only 1" on Tuesday.

regions.title: Northeast
regions.text: Killington tops the region at 11", with 8" on Friday, and the snow is expected Thursday and Friday. Stowe follows at 9" with 8" on Friday. Whiteface is at 8", and most of the week before Thursday brings a mix of rain and snow showers.

ahead.text: The Weather Prediction Center says a more organized storm is likely to reach the West Coast around Saturday Nov 14 into Sunday Nov 15, with heavier rain and high mountain snow pushing farther south. Confidence is moderate, and the track may still shift.
